title: writes the number as two figures
why: The figure written without its leading zero: the rail, the cell rows and the header's sentences would read 1 Data where the screens, the gate documents and the tests say 01 Data.

title: joins the number and the name with one space
why: The label joined otherwise: every cell group's name, the rail and the header's sentences would change wording together, and the one test per sentence would be the only place to notice.
